## About Me {#about}

<div class="about-content">
  <div class="about-image">
    <div class="image-placeholder">AL</div>
  </div>
  <div class="about-text">
    <p>I'm a data scientist and policy analyst with a background that bridges political science,
    procurement analytics, and public policy research. Currently finishing my M.S. in Data Science
    for Applied Public Policy at American University, I specialize in turning messy, real-world
    data into clear findings that inform decisions.</p>
    <p>My work spans electoral targeting and campaign strategy, digital privacy and reproductive
    rights policy, gender and labor economics, and supply chain analytics. I work primarily in
    Python and R, with a focus on making analysis reproducible, communicable, and actionable.</p>

      <h3>Collins for U.S. Senate 2026 — Campaign Plan & Data Targeting</h3>
      <p>Full campaign plan developed at the Campaign Management Institute (AU) for a
      competitive Georgia Senate race (Collins vs. Ossoff). Built a Python-based targeting
      model merging six county-level datasets across all 159 Georgia counties — election
      results, voter registration, and demographic data — to produce turnout projections,
      persuasion universes, and priority scores. Vote goal: 2,152,409 (52% of projected turnout).
      Total campaign budget modeled: $80M.</p>
      <ul class="timeline-tags">
        <li>Python</li>

      <h3>"Your Body, Their Data" — Reproductive Surveillance Policy Brief</h3>
      <p>Published in <em>The Public Purpose</em>, American University's peer-reviewed policy journal

      algorithmic inference have turned personal data — location history, period-tracking apps —
      into evidence for criminal prosecution. Proposes the "Digital Bodyguard Act," a federal
      statute establishing a prohibited-by-default regulatory standard for reproductive health data.</p>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  // Theme toggle
  const themeToggle = document.getElementById('themeToggle');
  if (themeToggle) {
    themeToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const isDark = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark';
      document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', isDark ? 'light' : 'dark');
      localStorage.setItem('theme', isDark ? 'light' : 'dark');
    });
    // Apply saved theme on load
    const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('theme');
    if (savedTheme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', savedTheme);
    }
  }

  // Mobile menu
  const mobileMenuBtn = document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn');
  const navLinks = document.querySelector('.nav-links');
  if (mobileMenuBtn && navLinks) {
    mobileMenuBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      navLinks.classList.toggle('active');
    });
  }

  // Scroll animations
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });

  document.querySelectorAll('.timeline-item, .project-card, .education-card, .skill-category').forEach(el => {
    observer.observe(el);
  });
});
</script>
